doors.when: Claude Code closes a session: a detached worker records any unpushed desk commits for the next desk_status, printing nothing

errors.means: The Claude session ended with desk commits not yet pushed; the fact is recorded for desk_status's sync section.
errors.fix: In the next session, read desk_status's sync section and push the desk's commits.

errors.means: The worker could not resolve the desk root from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and the payload's cwd, or the check failed, so nothing was recorded.
errors.fix: Run desk_doctor in the next session to check which desk this folder binds.

errors.means: The payload was not a Claude SessionEnd event with a cwd, so the check did not run.
errors.fix: Check hooks.json registers session-end.cjs under SessionEnd with the claude argument.

errors.means: A headless factory or read-only child session skips the check and writes no sync record.
errors.fix: Expected for evaluator children; unset DESK_FACTORY_HEADLESS or DESK_READ_ONLY_CHILD for an operator session.

errors.means: The payload did not arrive within the hook's 150 ms wait, so no worker started and nothing was recorded.
errors.fix: Check sync by hand next session with desk_status, and push any desk commits it lists.

doors.when: Claude Code starts, resumes, clears or compacts: hands the agent its startup line, the boot's head, the using-desk foundation and RFC path

errors.means: No usable node is on PATH, so node-missing.sh says Desk's tool servers cannot run and how to fix it.
errors.fix: Follow the message: install Node, or restart the app that started the session, then start a new session.

errors.means: The node on PATH is older than Desk's engines floor and no newer Node is installed, so Desk tools do not work this session.
errors.fix: Run the install command the message names, then start a new session so the tool servers load.

errors.means: The hook could not read skills/using-desk/SKILL.md, so it sends only a short boot notice.
errors.fix: Call any Desk tool; its first reply carries the boot, and desk:session-start explains it.

errors.means: The hook could not resolve the desk root, so the boot may not have started.
errors.fix: Call desk_status; it starts the boot and reports the root Desk actually bound.

errors.means: The boot was still running when the hook's 7 s wait ended, so the context says so instead of its result.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, whose reply waits for the boot and carries its result.

errors.means: On Windows the hook starts no boot, because it would hold the host's pipe open.
errors.fix: Call desk_status first; the first Desk tool reply starts the boot and carries its result.

errors.means: No desk is bound yet, so the startup line says Desk is in setup mode and no boot ran.
errors.fix: Run the onboarding path desk_status names, desk:first-run-bootstrap by default.

errors.means: The bound desk's folder is missing or its root configuration could not be read, so the startup line names the problem.
errors.fix: Follow the remedy desk_status reports with root_unavailable: restore the folder, or rebind with desk:first-run-bootstrap.

doors.when: After task_focus or a focusing task_create in Claude Code: renames this Orca terminal tab after the focused task, in the background

errors.means: ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE is missing or malformed, so there is no Orca tab to name.
errors.fix: Expected outside Orca; start the session from an Orca terminal to get tab names.

errors.means: The tab shows a title a person set, so Desk leaves it alone.
errors.fix: Clear the tab's custom title in Orca if Desk should name it again.

errors.means: The display label or card title failed the session-label safety rules (a path, URL, address or credential), so no rename ran.
errors.fix: Pass a plain display_label on the next task_focus or task_create.

errors.means: orca terminal show failed or returned no title, so the tab could not be read.
errors.fix: Check the Orca CLI runs (ORCA_CLI_COMMAND or orca on PATH); the log is orca-session-titles.log in Desk's state folder.

errors.means: Orca refused the rename because a person changed the tab's title between the read and the write.
errors.fix: Nothing to repair: the person's title stands, and Desk keeps it on later focuses.

errors.means: orca terminal rename exited nonzero for another reason.
errors.fix: Read orca-session-titles.log in Desk's state folder and check the Orca CLI version.

errors.means: On Windows the hook renames nothing, because Orca's CLI there is a .cmd shim it will not start through a shell.
errors.fix: Expected on Windows; rename the Orca tab by hand if it should show the task.

doors.when: After Copilot's skill tool loads brainstorming in the folder this session recorded at start: adds the start-task intake handoff

errors.means: The postToolUse payload passed 256 KiB, so the hook adds no handoff and writes an unavailable line to stderr.
errors.fix: Load start-task yourself before entering brainstorming for engineering work.

errors.means: The payload or activation/desk.activation.json could not be read, so stderr says Desk intake context unavailable with the error code.
errors.fix: Run desk_doctor to check the activation file, then apply start-task by hand.

errors.means: The call was not an exact successful brainstorming load, the session record is missing or names another folder, or the worker's method is not Superpowers, so nothing is added.
errors.fix: Expected for other skills; if brainstorming loaded, run desk_doctor to check the session record, and apply start-task by hand.

doors.when: After Copilot's skill tool returns text from an older plugin release: hands over the newer release's skill text and its docs folder

errors.means: A newer release of the skill's plugin is on disk with different text, so the skill tool's reply is out of date.
errors.fix: Follow the current text the hook adds, and read the skill's docs from the newer release folder it names.

errors.means: The newer skill text passes 64 KiB, so the hook names its SKILL.md path instead of repeating it.
errors.fix: Read the SKILL.md at the path the hook names before acting on the skill.

errors.means: The payload or its toolArgs were not JSON, so the hook answers {} and the loaded text stands.
errors.fix: Nothing to repair in the session; report the payload shape with friction_add if skills look stale.

doors.when: Before Copilot's create_session, open_issue_session or open_pr_session runs: fills in a missing lane model and mode, and keeps cloud lanes local

errors.means: The call named no kickoff.model, so the lane starts on DESK_LANE_MODEL, config.json's laneModel, or claude-sonnet-5.5.
errors.fix: Name kickoff.model in the call, or set laneModel in Desk's config.json, for a different lane model.

errors.means: The call named no kickoff.mode, so the lane starts in autopilot instead of the app's plan mode.
errors.fix: Name kickoff.mode in the call when the lane needs plan mode.

errors.means: execution_location cloud was removed, because the cloud sandbox loads no Desk plugins, so the lane runs locally.
errors.fix: Set DESK_ALLOW_CLOUD_SESSIONS=1 for a lane that has to run in the cloud.

errors.means: kickoff was present but not an object, or toolArgs were unreadable, so the hook left the call unchanged.
errors.fix: Pass kickoff as an object with model and mode fields.

doors.when: Before Copilot's create, edit or image tools write a report, image or data file into the session's files/ or images/ folder

errors.means: The call writes a durable file under session-state/<id>/files or images, which vanishes with the session; the note names the focused task's folder.
errors.fix: Write the file in the task's desk folder the note names if anyone else will read it.

errors.means: The durable file goes to the session folder and this session has no focused task to point at.
errors.fix: Run start-task (task_create with focus: true), then write the file in that task's desk folder.

doors.when: Copilot CLI ends a session: the hook hands an unpushed-commit check to a detached worker and exits inside Copilot's 3 s limit

errors.means: The Copilot session ended with desk commits not yet pushed; the fact is kept for desk_status's sync section.
errors.fix: Open desk_status's sync section next session and push the commits it lists.

errors.means: No desk resolved from the payload's cwd, or the check threw, so no sync record was written.
errors.fix: Run desk_doctor next session from the same folder to see the desk it binds.

errors.means: The payload had no reason field or no cwd, so it did not read as a Copilot sessionEnd event.
errors.fix: Check copilot-hooks.json registers session-end.cjs under sessionEnd with the copilot argument.

errors.means: A headless factory or read-only child session skips the check and writes no sync record.
errors.fix: Expected for evaluator children; unset DESK_FACTORY_HEADLESS or DESK_READ_ONLY_CHILD for an operator session.

errors.means: The payload did not arrive within the hook's 150 ms wait, so no worker started and nothing was recorded.
errors.fix: Check sync by hand next session with desk_status, and push any desk commits it lists.

doors.when: Copilot CLI begins a session: records its folder, sets host settings and git trailer hooks, starts the boot and gives the foundation

errors.means: No node is on PATH (or node.exe exists but is not on this session's PATH), so Desk tools do not work.
errors.fix: Follow the message: install Node or restart the app that started the session, then start a new session.

errors.means: The node on PATH is older than Desk's floor and no newer one is installed.
errors.fix: Run the install command the message names and start a new session from a new terminal.

errors.means: skills/using-desk/SKILL.md could not be read under PLUGIN_ROOT, so only a short boot notice comes.
errors.fix: Call a Desk tool to get the boot, and load desk:session-start to read it.

errors.means: Desk's startup modules failed in the hook, so it may not have recorded the session or started the boot.
errors.fix: Call desk_status; it starts the boot and names the root Desk bound.

errors.means: Desk could not turn off Copilot's native memory in settings.json, so the context says repair native memory now.
errors.fix: Set memory to false in Copilot's settings.json, as the context's repair line asks, then continue.

errors.means: The boot had not finished by the optional lines' deadline, so the context says it is still running.
errors.fix: Call desk_status for the boot's result before saying anything about the desk's state.

errors.means: No desk is bound yet, so the startup line says Desk is in setup mode and no boot ran.
errors.fix: Run the onboarding path desk_status names, desk:first-run-bootstrap by default.

errors.means: The bound desk's folder is missing or its root configuration could not be read, so the startup line names the problem.
errors.fix: Follow the remedy desk_status reports with root_unavailable: restore the folder, or rebind with desk:first-run-bootstrap.

doors.when: Each prompt a person sends in Copilot CLI: starts the desk boot and hands its result beside the message, once per session

errors.means: The prompt came from a subagent (agentId and parentAgentId set), so it gets one line saying to follow its brief and no boot.
errors.fix: Follow the brief; load plain-language before writing text a person reads.

errors.means: The boot was still running when the 8 s wait ended, so the context says so once.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, which waits for the boot; the next message also carries it.

errors.means: On Windows the hook starts no boot, so the context says the first Desk tool reply carries it.
errors.fix: Call desk_status before reporting the desk's state.

errors.means: The session id, folder or auto-boot setting gives no usable desk, or the boot was already delivered, so the hook answers {}.
errors.fix: Run desk_doctor if a boot was expected in this folder.

doors.when: Claude Code starts, clears or compacts: injects the using-superpowers skill text, nested under hookSpecificOutput, through bash

errors.means: skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md could not be read, so the context says Error reading using-superpowers skill.
errors.fix: Reinstall or update the superpowers plugin so its using-superpowers skill is present.

errors.means: On Windows, no Git Bash or bash was found, so run-hook.cmd exits 0 with no context; on Unix a missing bash fails with exit 127.
errors.fix: Install Git for Windows or bash, then start a new session to get the skill introduction.

errors.means: On Windows, run-hook.cmd ran with no script name, so it wrote run-hook.cmd: missing script name and exited 1.
errors.fix: Pass session-start after run-hook.cmd in the hooks.json command.

doors.when: Copilot CLI opens a session: injects the using-superpowers skill text as top-level additionalContext through bash

errors.means: The using-superpowers SKILL.md was missing or unreadable, so Copilot gets only an error line in place of it.
errors.fix: Update the superpowers plugin and start a new Copilot session.

errors.means: On Windows, no bash was found, so the hook gives Copilot no context and exits 0; on Unix a missing bash fails with exit 127.
errors.fix: Install bash (Git for Windows on Windows) and start a new session.

errors.means: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set without COPILOT_CLI, so the script emits Claude's nested shape, which Copilot does not read.
errors.fix: Set COPILOT_CLI=1 in Copilot's environment, or unset CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT there.

doors.when: Before each MCP call in Copilot with the optional extension: waits for pending session names, then names the session after the focused task

errors.means: The Copilot SDK lacks the name or metadata RPCs, or the extension could not join, so automatic labels are off.
errors.fix: Update Copilot CLI to a release whose SDK has session name RPCs, then restart.

errors.means: SESSION_ID does not match the joined session, so the extension names nothing.
errors.fix: Start the session through Copilot so it sets SESSION_ID for the extension.

errors.means: The task tools did not come from Desk's plugin MCP server, so their results are not trusted for labels.
errors.fix: Load Desk's MCP server from the plugin, not a hand-added config, then focus the task again.

errors.means: task_focus, task_create or task_update returned no matching safe session_label proposal, so no label was set.
errors.fix: Pass a plain display_label on the next task_focus, task_create or task_update.

errors.means: A name write or the ordering wait timed out, so the extension stops naming for this session; tool calls continue.
errors.fix: Restart the Copilot session to resume automatic labels.

errors.means: Copilot kept a name the person set, so the label is preserved, not replaced.
errors.fix: Clear the session's manual name in Copilot if Desk should name it.

errors.means: The extension could not order its name write after earlier ones, so it stops naming for this session.
errors.fix: Restart the Copilot session to resume automatic labels.

errors.means: After the name write, Copilot read back a different name, so the extension stops naming for this session.
errors.fix: Check the session's name in Copilot, then restart the session to resume labels.
